scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production node server/src/index.js
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && node --experimental-strip-types --test client/src/lib/placeLabel.test.ts client/src/lib/alertSummary.test.ts client/src/lib/splitLink.test.ts client/src/i18n/locale.test.ts client/src/i18n/screen.test.ts
